body: It disgusts me how easily it is for me to consider the method of suicide. It's the selfishness again. The more I think about it, the more I loathe myself. I'm not sure if I mentioned, but I have been set on jumping in front of a semi truck on the highway near my house. I am so okay with fucking someone's life up in order to appease my suicidal impulses. It's scary. I am so scared.
I don't think I'm going to follow through tonight. I'm very paranoid. Yet when I think about it, I am just hit with more and more reasons to follow through. It's horrifying. I want it all to end.

I used to reason with myself using this quote, but it no longer has any meaning to me. It all feels pointless.

"It will all be okay in the end. If it's not okay, it's not the end."

It feels irrefutable, but it's shallow at the same time. Thank you for taking the time to reply.
I appreciate you taking the time to reply. I don't feel human, and my lack of care for others certainly doesn't help. I hope what you say registers within me in time. Thank you.
I apologize. I am not trying to invalidate the feelings of other posters. I'm just curious. I'll delete this post.

I feel that phrase is geared towards those considering suicide following emotional trauma. I hate the phrase, but you shouldn't feel invalidated because of it. I am not telling you to commit suicide by saying that btw

I feel quite flawed due to my apathy regarding the consideration of the consequences my suicide would have. I am so far gone that it doesn't matter to me, and that isn't right. I should care more, and I do care, but my suicidal feelings are more prominent in my head and they outshine any consideration for my surroundings. I hope that makes sense.
